news.title: LEAGUE OF CHAMPIONS - THIS TUESDAY
news.body: A new mode lands on Tuesday 13 October: pick your club and chase the cup. A lot of work went into this one. Tell us what you think on Instagram. And if a friend would love it too, we would be so grateful if you showed them the game.

news.title: SHARING IS CARING
news.body: Thank you for playing! If you enjoy the game, please share it with a friend. Every share helps us grow.

news.title: DID YOU LIKE THE NEW MODE?
news.body: The League of Nations is here. One tap - tell us what you think.

prizes.title: A GIFT: 2 FREE SKIPS
prizes.body: Thanks for playing Crossbar Challenge. Stuck on a level? Press SKIP and use one - no ad.
